title: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
abstract: arXiv:2610.29122v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respects the printed median, interval and event count. We propose StochIKM, a stochastic algorithm that digitizes the figure with a vision-capable language model and uses the high-fidelity definition as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets. translated_title: StochIKM：从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线自动高保真重建个体患者数据
translated_abstract: 个体患者数据是时间-事件证据二次分析的金标准，但很少被公开，而从已发表的Kaplan-Meier图形中重建数据可以有所帮助。现有方法都声称具有高保真度，各自以自己恰好达成的一致性指标作为评判标准，且每种方法都只返回单一数据集，尽管从图形到数据的映射并非一一对应。我们显式地定义了保真度：当一个数据集能够完全复现风险表、在图像分辨率范围内贴合数字化曲线、并符合印刷的中位数、区间和事件数时，该数据集即为可采纳的。我们提出了StochIKM，一种随机算法，它利用具备视觉能力的语言模型对图形进行数字化，并将高保真定义作为约束条件，返回一组可采纳的个体患者数据集。只要图形被正确读取，解就必然存在，因此求解失败则表明已发表的图形本身或读取过程存在问题。
tldr: 提出StochIKM随机算法，利用视觉语言模型数字化已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线，并以显式定义的高保真约束（精确复现风险表、在图像分辨率内贴合曲线、符合印刷统计量）为条件，返回一组可采纳的个体患者数据集，克服了现有方法保真度定义模糊且仅输出单一数据集的局限。
en_tdlr: StochIKM is a stochastic algorithm that digitizes published Kaplan-Meier curves with a vision-capable language model and uses an explicit high-fidelity definition (exact risk table reproduction, curve fitting within image resolution, and consistency with printed statistics) as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets rather than a single one, thereby overcoming the vague fidelity criteria and single-output limitation of existing methods.
